# KUBU 2.0.0

One CSS file for server-rendered HTML. Link `kubu.min.css` (attached below) and compose BEM parts; the browser runs the components with `<dialog>`, `<details>`, `popover`, `:target`, radios and checkboxes.

## Get it

- **Direct:** download `kubu.min.css` from this release and link it.
- **npm:** `npm install kubu-css`, then link `node_modules/kubu-css/dist/kubu.min.css`.
- **pip:** `pip install kubu-css`, then `{% static 'kubu/kubu.min.css' %}` in Django.

## What changed

- Dark-first tokens (`--dark-*` paired with `--light-*` through `light-dark()`); with no saved choice the page follows the system.
- A 12-column grid and an auto-fit grid.
- The docs are one htmx site of plain pages: each address is an endpoint, `hx-boost` swaps only the content, and every link still works with scripts off.
- `pages/v2.html` states the 2.0 contract on one page.
- `packages/`: a starter site (`web`), typography and icon slices, htmx patterns (`plugin`) and the optional JS modules (`js`).
- The Vue front end is gone. KUBU does not ship code for a UI library.
- Form controls use the page font, and every control is at least 44 by 44 pixels with a visible focus ring. Text meets WCAG AA contrast in dark and light.

## Assets

- `kubu.min.css`: the whole framework, minified (about 60 KB)
- `kubu.css`: the same, readable
